messages:
sel: quick idea for today's sync  add a "compare mode" to the timepicker. click a snapshot to pin a window and show it as a faint outline on the heatmap/p95 so you can eyeball drift without swapping ranges. session by default, with an optional 'save comparison' permalink.

jorge: interested. two UX asks: how do people create snapshots (keyboard + mouse) and how visible is the outline when charts are dense?

mei: propose creation via a small bookmark icon in the picker and keyboard shortcut (Enter when focused). for visibility: outline should be dashed + 40% opacity and we can toggle fill vs outline in accessibility mode. also show a subtle label like "compare: deploy-2025-04-01" on hover.

conrad: sampling caveat  our per-bucket reservoir sampling can make p95 appear different when you shift windows. options: 1) bucket-align snapshots (complex), 2) show bucket edges overlay when a snapshot is active, 3) show a "sampled" chip with sample rate. leaning to 2+3.

mei: overlay idea: draw thin vertical lines at bucket boundaries for the current view when snapshot active. add tooltip: "Bucket edges: sampling boundaries". that helps explain small jumps.

sel: also like a tiny ghost of the previous p95 line (semi-transparent) so you can see absolute shift vs distribution changes. call it "p95 ghost".

jorge: copy nits: button label "Capture snapshot" (avoid 'pin' to reduce confusion). tooltip: "Capture this time window for quick comparison." sample chip: "Sampled view" with hover text: "This chart uses sampled data (%s). Click to run full scan (costly)."

conrad: backend note: we can emit sampling_rate and sampling_strategy per query and an api param snapshot_mode=stream|exact. streaming will show ghost/outline quickly; exact re-run is slower. small pseudocode: \n```\n# per-bucket reservoir (simplified)\nfor b in buckets:\n  s = reservoir_sample(b, k)\n  emit_stats(s)\n```\nso p95 can jitter. we'll add a flag to surface bucket_edges in the response when snapshot_mode=stream.

mei: accessibility: snapshot creation reachable by keyboard; new snapshot announced via aria-live: "Snapshot created: <label>"; outline and ghost must meet contrast and not rely on color alone; provide pattern (dashed/fill toggle). focus order: timepicker -> snapshots list -> heatmap.

a11y-bot: A11Y checklist:
• Snapshot action reachable by keyboard (Enter/Space).
• Announce snapshot creation with aria-live.
• Ghost/p95 outline uses shape + color, not color alone.
• Bucket-edge markers have accessible tooltip describing sampling boundaries.
• Focus order preserved.

ops-bot: Note: adding bucket_edges to response and sampling fields will change telemetry shape. Add a changelog entry and notify platform teams.

sel: next steps: mei to mock outline + p95 ghost + bucket-edge overlay frames; conrad/jorge to confirm api fields (sampling_rate, sampling_strategy, bucket_edges, snapshot_mode) and perf implications. quick sync Friday 9:30am. thanks team 49c

(emoji reactions: :thumbsup: :sparkles:)
